richiami.difetto: Rear emergency exit door frame may fracture.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and fit reinforcing corner brackets to the top and bottom of the rear end of the door.

richiami.difetto: The appliance mounted water tank may break loose and hit the rear of the crew cab in an accident situation.
richiami.modello: B TYPE FIRE APPLIANCE , B TYPE FIRE APPLIANCE
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected appliances and reinforce the existing water tank security measures by attaching the tank to the chassis rear crossmember with high tensile duplex nylon ties.
